description: Quantify what DDB1 does contact in the assembled CRL4(DDB2) and CRL4(CSA) ligases, as the positive counterpart to the DNA result
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def parse(t):
    L=t.splitlines(); i=0; n=len(L)
    while i<n:
        if L[i].startswith("loop_"):
            j=i+1; tags=[]
            while j<n and L[j].lstrip().startswith("_"): tags.append(L[j].strip()); j+=1
            if tags and tags[0].startswith("_atom_site."):
                recs=[]
                while j<n and not L[j].startswith("#") and not L[j].startswith("loop_"):
                    s=L[j].strip()
                    if s: recs.append(s.split())
                    j+=1
                cols=[x.split(".",1)[1] for x in tags]
                return pd.DataFrame([r for r in recs if len(r)==len(cols)],columns=cols)
            i=j
        else: i+=1

def load(p):
    df=parse(requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}.cif",timeout=240).text)
    df=df[df.group_PDB.isin(["ATOM","HETATM"])].copy()
    if "pdbx_PDB_model_num" in df: df=df[df.pdbx_PDB_model_num==df.pdbx_PDB_model_num.iloc[0]]
    df=df[(df.type_symbol!="H")&(df.label_comp_id!="HOH")]
    for c in ["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]: df[c]=pd.to_numeric(df[c],errors="coerce")
    df=df.dropna(subset=["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"])
    df["chain"]=df.auth_asym_id; df["comp"]=df.label_comp_id
    df["seq"]=pd.to_numeric(df.auth_seq_id,errors="coerce")
    return df

def iface(df, c1, c2, cut=4.0):
    a=df[df.chain==c1]; b=df[df.chain==c2]
    if len(a)==0 or len(b)==0: return None
    t=cKDTree(b[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].values)
    d,_=t.query(a[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].values,k=1)
    return dict(atoms_lt4=int((d<cut).sum()), residues_lt4=int(a.loc[d<cut,"seq"].nunique()),
                min_dist=round(float(d.min()),2),
                res_range=(f"{int(a.loc[d<cut,'seq'].min())}-{int(a.loc[d<cut,'seq'].max())}"
                           if (d<cut).any() else "-"))

# What DDB1 actually binds, measured in the holo-ligase structures
rows=[]
d4=load("4A0K")   # CUL4A(A) RBX1(B) DDB1(C) DDB2(D) DNA(E,F)
for partner,ch,lab in [("CUL4A","A","Cullin-4A"),("RBX1","B","RBX1"),("DDB2","D","DDB2 (DCAF)"),("DNA","E","DNA strand 1"),("DNA","F","DNA strand 2")]:
    r=iface(d4,"C",ch)
    if r: rows.append(dict(structure="4A0K (CRL4A-DDB2-DNA, 5.93 A)", ddb1_chain="C", partner=lab, **r))

d7=load("7OPC")   # CRL4(CSA)-Pol II; DDB1 = chain d
# identify chains by description
GQL="https://data.rcsb.org/graphql"
q="""query{entry(entry_id:"7OPC"){polymer_entities{rcsb_polymer_entity{pdbx_description}
 rcsb_polymer_entity_container_identifiers{auth_asym_ids}}}}"""
pe=requests.post(GQL,json={"query":q},timeout=120).json()["data"]["entry"]["polymer_entities"]
cmap={}
for p in pe:
    for ch in p["rcsb_polymer_entity_container_identifiers"]["auth_asym_ids"]:
        cmap[ch]=p["rcsb_polymer_entity"]["pdbx_description"]
for ch,desc in cmap.items():
    if ch=="d": continue
    r=iface(d7,"d",ch)
    if r and r["atoms_lt4"]>0:
        rows.append(dict(structure="7OPC (CRL4-CSA-Pol II, 3.0 A)", ddb1_chain="d", partner=f"{desc[:34]} (chain {ch})", **r))
for ch in ["N","T"]:
    r=iface(d7,"d",ch)
    if r: rows.append(dict(structure="7OPC (CRL4-CSA-Pol II, 3.0 A)", ddb1_chain="d", partner=f"DNA (chain {ch})", **r))

I=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values(["structure","atoms_lt4"],ascending=[True,False])
I.to_csv("TABLE_DDB1_interfaces.csv",index=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",220); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",50)
print("What DDB1 contacts, measured (heavy atoms < 4.0 A):\n")
print(I.to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,5))
sub=I[I.structure.str.startswith("4A0K")]
colors=["#B4442E" if "DNA" in p else "#2E8B57" for p in sub.partner]
ax.barh(range(len(sub)), sub.atoms_lt4, color=colors)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(sub))); ax.set_yticklabels(sub.partner)
ax.set_xlabel("DDB1 heavy atoms within 4 A of partner")
ax.set_title("PDB 4A0K, the assembled CRL4(DDB2) ligase on damaged DNA.\n"
             "DDB1 contacts CUL4A and DDB2; it contacts neither DNA strand.")
for i,(v,p) in enumerate(zip(sub.atoms_lt4, sub.min_dist)):
    ax.text(v+3, i, f"{v} atoms, closest {p} A", va="center", fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlim(0, sub.atoms_lt4.max()*1.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
